changes: One Modern design with Light and Full performance variants; migrate legacy Classic preference to Modern Light without resetting pins
Centered floating dock when shortcuts fit; stable item positions; direct left-edge navigation to sidebar and restored dock focus
Clean local Morph icons and transparent YouTube mark inside glass surfaces; remove extra focus outline and nested surface
Kids World remains available in dock; remove duplicate Prayer shortcut from dock while preserving sidebar
Content-sized top navigation; prayer clock respects 12/24-hour setting and separates countdown label
Shared theme tokens retained in Settings, IPTV and Radio; prayer artwork preserved; Arabic and English text scaling verified
Broader recognized local USB media extensions and full-screen Samsung playback controls with AVPlay/HTML fallback
Android selected-file MIME inference and private fullscreen local-video player with remote controls and external-player fallback
limitations: No physical television tested in this release; platform API fixtures and desktop rendered UI used
Media container recognition does not guarantee that a television supports its codecs
LG USB entry uses the supported installed media-player path; full mounted-file enumeration is not claimed
Legacy Android 0.1.1 package remains unchanged; experimental Tizen 4 compatibility remains subject to physical-device testing
